topic: BUILD: a 20-minute one-page list of every account that has your name on it, with shared accounts marked for later
pillar: BUILD: the first-hour setup and slow foundations (list your accounts, pull your credit report, change passwords, list bills, a small cushion).
caption:
Do you know every account that has your name on it?

Today's BUILD step is one sheet of paper and about twenty minutes.
Open your banking app, last month's statements and that pile of mail.
For each account, write the name, what it is, whether it's shared, and who can log in.
Put a star next to the shared ones. You don't have to fix anything today.

Save this for when you have a quiet twenty minutes.
If you'd like a page made for this list, The Day Zero Workbook has one. It's in my Stan store, link in bio.

If someone else controls your accounts and you feel unsafe, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 1-800-799-7233.

Day one counts.

General education, not financial advice.

slides.title: Every account with your name on it
slides.subtitle: A one-page list in 20 minutes

slides.title: Start with one sheet of paper
slides.body: Before you plan anything, it helps to know what exists. Today's step is a list of every account that has your name on it. One page. About twenty minutes.

slides.title: Pull up these first
items: Your banking app and any old bank emails
Last month's credit card and loan statements
Your phone bill, insurance and utilities
Retirement or work accounts from any job, old or current
The mail you have been meaning to open

slides.title: Write down four things
items: The name of the place, like your bank or card company
What it is: checking, savings, card, loan, or a bill
Yours alone, or shared with someone else
Who can log in or see it today

slides.title: Put a star next to the shared ones
slides.body: Joint accounts and shared logins are the ones to look at first. You do not have to change anything today. A star is enough. A licensed professional can help with the next steps.

slides.title: Missing a statement? Write FIND and keep going
slides.body: If you can't find a login or a statement, write the word FIND next to it and move on. A half-finished list still shows you more than you could see this morning.

slides.title: Keep your list somewhere safe
slides.body: Save this post for the twenty minutes you set aside. The Day Zero Workbook has a page made for this list, if you want one. It's in my Stan store, link in bio. Day one counts.
